decision.reason: [ev-61893aebc612] is a one-line release note saying an optional prefix was added to the AWS Secrets Manager provider. It doesn't say which environments this affects, and it names no consequence for existing stores. The proposed condition (any SecretStore with spec.provider.aws set) is a guess. It also flags AWS stores that don't use Secrets Manager, which makes it too broad, and it leaves out ClusterSecretStore, which makes it too narrow. The CRD validator found the field in the schema of both releases [ev-9889c9b8706d][ev-e08924afdc47]. Whether this is a new field at all is unresolved, so the PR diff or schema details for the provider service are needed before the exposure can be fixed.
